description: Sovereign AI OS billing skill definitions. Covers MSA v1.0.0 (direct) and MSA v1.1.0 (reseller addendum) obligations.

skills.name: calculateOverage
skills.description: Calculates the metered overage charge for a completed voice or SMS event.

actual_units.description: Actual minutes consumed or messages sent in the billing period.

included_units.description: Units covered by the Essentials Bundle; overage begins above this threshold.

rate.description: Per-unit overage rate from pricing_v1.yaml (e.g. 0.25 for Phone Voice AI).

overage_charge.description: Dollar amount owed for overage. Zero if actual_units <= included_units.

side_effects: increment_usage(customerId, eventType, quantity) must be called before this skill runs.
Result must be reported to Stripe Metered Billing within the same billing cycle.

skills.name: verifyCompliance
skills.description: Validates that a customer meets all regulatory requirements before SMS messaging is enabled.

ein.description: Customer's Employer Identification Number. Must be a valid 9-digit EIN.

business_address.description: Verified physical address of the business (street, city, state, zip, country).

a2p_campaign_id.description: Registered A2P 10DLC Campaign SID. Must be active and approved by carrier.

consent_records_verified.description: Attestation that Prior Express Written Consent records exist for all messaging recipients.

skills.logic: Return PASS only if EIN is valid AND address is verified AND a2p_campaign_id is active AND consent_records_verified is true.

status.description: PASS enables SMS. FAIL blocks SMS and surfaces a rejection reason.

rejection_reason.description: Human-readable reason for FAIL. Must be written to the operator log.

side_effects: On FAIL, SMS dispatch must be hard-blocked — not silently dropped.
Rejection reason must be written to the operator compliance log.

skills.name: handleEarlyTermination
skills.description: Calculates the early termination fee owed when a customer cancels after the 30-day grace period but before the end of the Primary Term.

current_day.description: Number of calendar days since the Activation Date (Day 1 = Activation Date).

remaining_flat_fees.description: Sum of all Flat Fees ($49.00/mo) remaining in the Primary Term at the time of cancellation.

rule_of_31.description: The grace period covers Days 1–30 inclusive. Early termination fees are ONLY applicable if current_day is strictly greater than 30. This check must appear as the first guard clause in any implementation of this skill.

if_false.reason: Cancellation within the 30-day Verizon Grace Period. No penalty applies.

termination_fee.description: Dollar amount owed. Zero if current_day <= 30.

fee_basis.description: Explanation string for the invoice line item (e.g. '75% of 9 remaining months at $49.00/mo').

side_effects: Fee must be invoiced via Stripe immediately upon cancellation confirmation.
Suspension logic (MSA §6.2) applies if this invoice goes 15+ days unpaid.

skills.name: calculateResellerMargin
skills.description: Calculates the net payout owed to a Reseller after deducting the wholesale base rate and Stripe processing fees from the retail price collected. Credits the result to resellerCommissionBalance and schedules a Stripe Connect transfer.

retail_price.description: The full amount collected from the end-customer via Stripe (the Reseller's markup price).

wholesale_base.description: The Vendor's base rate per Sub-Account per month. Source: pricing_v1.yaml → wholesale_v1.base_rate (default: 49.00).

stripe_processing_fee.description: Stripe transaction fee for the collected payment (typically 2.9% + $0.30 for card transactions). Must be calculated at runtime, not hardcoded.

reseller_account_id.description: The Master UUID of the RESELLER account. Used to look up wholesaleRate (custom rate override) and credit resellerCommissionBalance.

skills.wholesale_override_logic: If customerAccounts.wholesaleRate != 49.00 for this reseller, use that value as wholesale_base instead of the default.

reseller_payout.description: Dollar amount credited to resellerCommissionBalance. Must be >= 0; if negative, log a pricing configuration error.

payout_summary.description: Human-readable breakdown for the Reseller Dashboard (e.g. '$149.00 collected − $49.00 wholesale − $4.62 processing = $95.38 margin').

side_effects: Credit resellerCommissionBalance in customerAccounts by reseller_payout amount.
If stripeConnectedAccountId is set on the Reseller account, schedule a Stripe Connect transfer for the payout on the Vendor's standard disbursement schedule.
If stripeConnectedAccountId is null, hold balance in resellerCommissionBalance until Stripe Connect onboarding is completed.
Log a compliance audit event with reseller_account_id, sub_account_id, retail_price, wholesale_base, stripe_processing_fee, and reseller_payout for financial reconciliation.
